text:
morgan: Heads up — onboarding sample app hitting intermittent 401s when auth refresh happens during a streaming call. Seen on Android 12/14 emulators and Pixel 8. Steps to repro: open app -> long streaming generate -> perform account switch. Anyone seen this?

alex: hmm, is token refresh double-sent? retrofit / okHttp config?

morgan: I think so. Logs show a retry then 401 then retry loop. The refresh request sometimes cancels the original call and OkHttp reuses connection then 401. Using coroutine cancellation + OkHttp Call.cancel().

jamal: can you paste the interceptor code? sometimes we forget to clone request body for retries.

morgan: pasted code: ```kotlin
class AuthInterceptor: Interceptor {
  override fun intercept(chain: Interceptor.Chain): Response {
    val token = tokenProvider.get()
    val newReq = chain.request().newBuilder().header("Authorization","Bearer $token").build()
    val resp = chain.proceed(newReq)
    if (resp.code == 401) {
      synchronized(this) {
        val fresh = tokenRefresher.refresh() // refresh blocking
        return chain.proceed(newReq.newBuilder().header("Authorization","Bearer $fresh").build())
      }
    }
    return resp
  }
}
```

sophie: two things: 1) don't block inside interceptor with refresh that mutates tokenProvider for other threads, it's racy. 2) Retrofit has Authenticator interface for 401 flows — use that instead.

morgan: we did try Authenticator but saw duplicate refresh calls (race) — two requests hit 401 and both call refresh causing refresh endpoint 429.

alex: use a refresh lock + allow only one refresh future, return the same token to waiting callers. Also ensure authenticator doesn't run on the refresh request itself (check header).

morgan: tried that, still weird: on Android 14 with TLS 1.3 session resumption it seems connection reuse leads to the original request being retried without new header. Could be OkHttp connection pool + call.clone behavior.

jamal: are you using OkHttp 4.11? There's a fix for header propagation on retries in 4.11.1 — check changelog.

morgan: building with 4.10.0. Will try 4.11.1. Also could be coroutine dispatcher switching; cancellation + resuming coroutine re-enqueues call. Any suggestions for sample app workaround?

sophie: For sample app, simplest: mark token refresh requests with header `X-Do-Not-Retry: true` and in authenticator skip if that header present. Also add `retryOnConnectionFailure(false)` for streaming route.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: sample-app/dev -> canary at 2026-03-23T12:30Z :rocket:

morgan: thanks — applying workaround in sample app branch `fix/auth-race-1778889999`. Will post results.

alex: if upgrade fixes it, could add note in devex doc about OkHttp versions + Authenticator pattern.

morgan: agreed. Will update docs.
